method: Read each repository at origin/main, inspect source ownership, CI, tests, documents, generated mirrors, receipts, evidence, active experiments, and cross-repository consumers. Counts are descriptive signals, not automatic failure thresholds.

observations: ordivon-protocol package metadata is 0.5.0 while projects/conformance.toml and the immutable release manifest remain 0.3.0
the full conformance gate exits 2 with protocol package version differs
the protocol-release check and foundational-document check each report success on the same revision
the Harness protocol module is 583 lines and has one implementation consumer: ordivon-harness
research/map.yaml is 642 lines; research/portfolio.json is 165 lines; only two questions are active
global coverage thresholds are 95 percent lines, 90 percent branches, and 95 percent functions
every push runs typecheck, web checks, coverage, browser E2E, receipt generation, two measurement suites, and release-input generation
milestone receipts and evaluation records exist from M0 through M5
the alpha release uploads, downloads, and fully reverifies its own release artifacts
the current product-loop workspace is simplifying the player-facing experience after the validation and replay system expanded
tests/test_ordivon_harness_p0_p1.py is 1400 lines

durable execution uses TaskContract, TaskAttemptDescriptor, HarnessAssignment, ToolGrant, NativeHarnessRunContract, Tool Step Intent, DispatchFence, Receipt, Snapshot, delta state, recovery, completion proposal, verification, and decision objects
Harness continuity objects were promoted into ordivon-protocol despite one implementation consumer
three historical live-provider tracks retain dedicated receipt checkers and tests
the generic HostExtensionPort currently has one external consumer: ordivon-harness
object retention is partly inferred from payload field names ending in ObjectDigest or ObjectDigests
HistoryValidation and OperatorHandoffCapsule are separately defined by Host and Harness
the prior A-series audit found unconsumed durable states and a 645-line generic EffectLifecycleHost without two real consumers
most verification is directly coupled to the product responsibility: stable operation identity, at-most-once dispatch, evidence, cancellation, reconciliation, and recovery
release acceptance and CodeQL are manual rather than repeated on every change
Runtime has the lowest document-to-code ratio and one of the lowest test-to-code ratios in the current portfolio
real adversarial experiments now exist and the experiment/evaluation split is meaningful
the repository's own A11 audit classifies Campaign Manifest, ledger, and coordinator v0 as about 4.6k active contract LOC with historical reproduction as the only current consumer
the default CI runs the entire deterministic Round 1 acceptance on every push and pull request
CHARTER.md still names retired Link and Edge ownership while README.md names World
committed generated article metadata is 1393 lines
pnpm check runs content synchronization, then regenerates content in typecheck, then regenerates it again in build
pull-request checks and the main-branch deployment workflow both install Chromium and run the full check
curated system views manually repeat project and architecture state owned by other repositories
W1 and the complete WCP-0 through WXP-2 program both concluded that no independent World authority, service, database, broker, workflow engine, callback journal, or artifact-transfer layer was earned
the repository still couples a Cloudflare provider and a network-observation module under one semantic repository
default CI reruns completed W1, WXP-1, and WXP-2 experiments and checks generated capability and closeout projections on every push
the retained production capabilities have independent owners, dependencies, toolchains, and failure modes

cross_system_findings: validation and audit machinery was repeatedly exempted from Core A11 cost and deletion tests
local checks often prove mutually incomplete properties; green subchecks do not guarantee a coherent repository state
negative architectural experiments were recorded but their historical machinery remained in default CI and active source layouts
audits increased reports, receipts, schemas, and tests more reliably than they deleted active structure
manual projections in Computer and Web duplicate state owned by product repositories and drift with them
the portfolio's present bottleneck is judgment, product usefulness, and attention allocation rather than lack of additional validation artifacts
